<thought>Based on the 13C NMR data, the peaks in the typical aromatic region (≈110‑160 ppm) are: 142.60, 133.69, 133.25, 132.62, 130.15 (two signals), 129.32, 128.37, 128.16, 127.72, 127.15 (two signals), 126.45, 125.88, 125.73, and 125.50. This gives a total of 16 aromatic carbon signals. The peak at 166.40 is likely a carbonyl carbon, and 52.24 is aliphatic, so they are not counted as aromatic.</thought>
<final_answer>16</final_answer>
